source: ASSUMED: authored game preset (weather plan 7.3), not a measurement. The intensity is chosen inside the class it represents (data/weather_classes/wmo_dwd_torro.json: WMO-No. 8 intensity classes, DWD Warnkriterien, TORRO); every other number (cloud cover, wind, RH, offsets) is ASSUMED plausible for the phenomenon. 20 mm/h = WMO heavy rain (10-50); held for 1 h it reaches DWD Starkregen (15-25 mm/1 h).
